title: Request TTL Expiry Job
last_note: Implementation complete. Added ConnectionExpiryScheduler (@Scheduled fixedRate=60000, @EnableScheduling added to ConnectionServiceApplication), ConnectionService.findOverdueConnectionRequestIds()/expireConnectionRequest(Long) (split into two interface methods instead of one, to avoid the Spring self-invocation pitfall that would have silently broken the per-request @Transactional/Outbox atomicity if the loop and the transactional transition lived in the same class), ConnectionRequestRepository.findByStatusAndExpiresAtBefore, and ConnectionExpiredEvent (event_id, connection_id, requester_id only, matching contracts/kafka/connection.expired.schema.json's additionalProperties:false exactly). No Flyway migration needed (EXPIRED already existed in ConnectionStatus enum from T029/T030; no new columns). No CLI codegen commands were required for this ticket.
